calibration_note: A seeded random sample of 500 rows fits temperature; a separate 1000-row sample fits the conformal threshold; the other 1500 rows are evaluation-only. The split manifest records exact indices, sample IDs, and input hashes.

regional_evaluation.limitations: Descriptive regional diagnostics only; marginal split-conformal guarantees do not imply conditional or region-wise coverage. Wilson intervals assume independent Bernoulli observations and are not corrected for spatial dependence.
